case_studies.title: Shewanella GECKO oxygen comparison
case_studies.story_title_zh: 完整氧条件 ecModel 展示案例
case_studies.story_summary: Compare the iLJ1162 reference GEM with the highO2 GECKO-ready ecModel. Use KEGG-derived submaps to explain kcat evidence, flux signals, and GECKO behavior.
case_studies.story_summary_zh: 对比 iLJ1162 参考 GEM 与 highO2 GECKO-ready ecModel，用 KEGG 派生子图解释 kcat 证据、通量信号和 GECKO 行为。
display_caveats: GECKO enzyme pseudo reactions are interpreted as constraint evidence, not conventional GEM structural diff.
Reaction-level capacity is displayed only when an existing capacity table is available.
display_next_actions: Open Model Compare and inspect TCA, glycolysis, and PPP KEGG-derived submaps.
Keep enzyme capacity marked unavailable unless reaction-level capacity output is present.

case_studies.title: P. putida acetate tolerance and isoprenol
case_studies.title_zh: P. putida 乙酸耐受与 isoprenol 论文案例
case_studies.story_title_zh: 蛋白组驱动的乙酸耐受证据案例
case_studies.story_summary: Use the P. putida acetate/isoprenol proteomics study to compare the reference model with a consensus context variant and explain acetate assimilation and MEP/isoprenol marker evidence.
case_studies.story_summary_zh: 基于 P. putida 乙酸/isoprenol 蛋白组论文，对比参考模型与 consensus context 变体，解释乙酸同化、MEP/isoprenol marker 证据。
case_studies.default_query: Pseudomonas putida iJN1463 acetate isoprenol proteomics
display_caveats: Use as proteomics plus kcat/package-ready evidence unless an external ecModel has been generated.
Capacity or enzyme usage should be shown as package-ready/not available when reaction-level output is absent.
display_next_actions: Show proteomics and marker annotation evidence in Model Compare.
Keep capacity and ecModel outputs marked external pending until a real ecModel run exists.

case_studies.title: Synechocystis SpkB carbon limitation
case_studies.title_zh: Synechocystis SpkB 碳限制论文案例
case_studies.story_title_zh: 证据整合型碳限制案例
case_studies.story_summary: Use proteomics, phosphoproteomics, metabolomics, and phenotype evidence to explain the SpkB carbon-limitation response. Treat the case as evidence integration unless a protein pool and external ecModel run are provided.
case_studies.story_summary_zh: 整合蛋白组、磷酸化蛋白组、代谢组与表型证据解释 SpkB 碳限制响应；在没有 protein pool 和外部 ecModel 运行前，按证据整合案例展示。
case_studies.default_query: Synechocystis iJN678 SpkB carbon limitation proteomics phosphoproteomics
display_caveats: This case is evidence-integration and kcat-ready unless a protein pool and external ecModel run are provided.
Do not report enzyme capacity as zero when reaction-level capacity is not generated.
display_next_actions: Use Model Compare for pathway/proteomics/phosphoproteomics evidence.
Do not show enzyme capacity as available without protein pool and external ecModel output.

case_studies.title: Shewanella transcriptional triggers in LAC/LB growth
case_studies.title_zh: Shewanella LAC/LB 生长动态转录触发因子论文复现
case_studies.story_title: Guarded evidence-chain reproduction of transcriptional triggers
case_studies.story_title_zh: 转录触发因子证据链复现案例
case_studies.story_summary: Uses Supplement and GEO processed data to show Growth State Map, Trigger Timeline, GDM-lite, paper-reported D2T2 triggers, and paper-reported dFBA/glycogen scenarios. Model Compare only overlays paper evidence that maps through GEM GPRs; nitrogen/glycogen regulators that do not map to reaction-level GPRs remain pathway-level caveats.
case_studies.story_summary_zh: 基于论文 Supplement 和 GEO processed matrix 展示 Growth State Map、Trigger Timeline、GDM-lite、论文报道的 D2T2 trigger 与 dFBA/glycogen scenario。Model Compare 只叠加可通过 GPR 真实映射到反应的 paper evidence；氮/糖原主线中未映射的调控基因保留为 pathway-level caveat。
case_studies.default_query: Shewanella transcriptional triggers LAC LB nitrogen glycogen GDM D2T2
display_caveats: GDM is a lightweight reproduction from processed expression and growth data, not the full original implementation.
D2T2 triggers and dFBA/glycogen curves are paper-reported tables; no full influence-network or solver recomputation is claimed.
Condition bounds, structural model edits, and enzyme capacity are not generated for this transcriptomics/metabolite paper.
Nitrogen/glycogen trigger genes are retained as paper evidence, but current iLJ1162 GPR mapping does not provide reaction-level overlay for that group.
Paper evidence reaction mapping is partial: 3 mapped genes, 14 unmapped genes.
display_next_actions: Use Analysis to inspect Growth State Map, Trigger Timeline, GDM-lite, D2T2, and dFBA/glycogen panels.
Use the default nitrogen/glycogen group for the paper story; switch to gluconeogenesis to inspect evidence reactions that map through iLJ1162 GPRs.
Keep bounds, fresh dFBA, and enzyme capacity marked unavailable unless curated parameters or external outputs are added.

case_studies.title: Shewanella integrated GECKO and trigger overview
case_studies.title_zh: Shewanella GECKO 与转录触发器综合展示
case_studies.story_title: Integrated Shewanella ecModel and paper-reproduction showcase
case_studies.story_title_zh: Shewanella ecModel 与论文复现综合案例
case_studies.story_summary: A single demonstration entry that links the GECKO oxygen-condition model comparison with the transcriptional-trigger paper reproduction workbench. Model Compare uses the GECKO run; Analysis and Summary use the trigger-paper run.
case_studies.story_summary_zh: 一个统一展示入口：Model Compare 使用 GECKO 氧条件对比 run，Analysis 与 Summary 使用转录触发器论文复现 run。
case_studies.default_query: Shewanella GECKO oxygen transcriptional triggers GDM D2T2 glycogen
display_caveats: This is a composite display case; it links two existing run packages instead of merging their files.
GECKO Compare evidence and trigger-paper Analysis evidence must remain stage-specific.
Fresh D2T2 recomputation, fresh dFBA solver runs, and fabricated enzyme capacity are out of scope.
display_next_actions: Use Model Compare for GECKO oxygen-condition evidence and kcat/proteomics overlays.
Use Analysis and Summary for Growth State Map, Trigger Timeline, GDM-lite, D2T2 reported triggers, and dFBA/glycogen paper-reported curves.
